title: Three employees struck by vehicle
narrative: Three employees were performing guardrail repairs on the interstate when a vehicle traveling at a high rate of speed fatally struck the employees.

title: Skid steer basket with employee falls to ground causing fata
narrative: An employee was trimming tree limbs with a chainsaw, while standing in a basket on the fork attachment of a skid steer. The basket attachment fell off the raised fork with the employee inside the basket causing fatal injuries.

title: Skid steer rollover into water fatally injures employee
narrative: An employee was operating a skid steer. The skid steer was found laying on its side with cab under water. The employee drowned.

title: Front loader fatally strikes worker
narrative: An employee was walking in front of a recycled asphalt building when he was fatally struck by a front loader vehicle.

title: Employee fell through an unguarded ladder hole opening on a
narrative: The employee was assisting in corrective maintenance replacement of a bracket for a relapse cylinder on the pivot platform of a crawler crane. The employee stepped back and fell through an unguarded ladder hole opening, sustaining fatal injuries.

title: Gunshot fatally injures employee
narrative: The employee was working behind the counter when a customer came into the store asking for items from behind the counter. The employee reached to provide the item to the customer and was fatally shot by the customer.

title: Employee is fatally injured in road roller roll-over inciden
narrative: The employee was operating a rubber-tired roller and assisting with the construction of a road into the site. The employee jumped from the roller when it went off the road surface. The roller struck the employee as it rolled on its side causing multiple fatal injuries.

title: Falling range target asphyxiates employee
narrative: An employee was working to realign a plywood target attached to a stationary armor target lift machine. The stationary armor target lift machine was present, and the plywood target was in the up position for employee to perform maintenance. The stationary armor target lift machine was requested to be offline. While the employee was using a hand impact tool to tighten bolts for the repositioned plywood target, the stationary armor target lift machine arms holding the plywood target came down pinning the employee causing fatal injuries.

title: Employee fell through an attic door opening causing fatal in
narrative: An employee working as a framer was completing a job in an attic at a new residential construction site. A few minutes after the employee entered the attic, he fell through the attic door opening to the floor below causing multiple fatal injuries.

title: Employee is fatally injured when struck by drill press arm
narrative: An employee was fabricating a part for an agricultural wagon using a drill press when it fell onto his head, causing multiple fatal injuries to the employee.

title: Employee electrocuted removing gutter
narrative: Employee was removing a gutter from a residential structure working from a pump-jack scaffold system erected 4.5 feet from a 79 kilovolt primary power line. The gutter contacted the power line and the employee was electrocuted.

title: Employee is fatally injured in fall from balcony
narrative: An employee was carrying metal panel siding to a balcony for installation. The employee lost his step and fell approximately 10 feet to the next balcony, resulting in fatal head injuries.

title: Employee is fatally injured in shooting incident
narrative: At 1:30 p.m. on February 28, 2025, Employee #1 was using the restroom when another employee shot and fatally injured the employee.

title: Employee sustains head injury when struck by forklift, later
narrative: At 9:00 a.m. on February 28, 2025, Employee #1 exited the forklift without setting the parking brake. The forklift rolled and trapped the employee's foot, pinning him between the forklift and the container. Employee #1 was found unconscious after he fell backwards striking his head. Employee #1 later passed away.

title: Employee is fatally injured in fall from RV roof
narrative: At 8:00 a.m. on February 28, 2025, Employee #1 was inspecting the caulking on the roof of an RV. The employee used the RV's built-in ladder to access the roof. While walking toward the front of the RV, the employee fell approximately 13 feet to the ground. As a result of the fall, the employee sustained fatal injuries.

title: Two employees are fatally injured when struck by falling fie
narrative: At 11:30 a.m. on February 28, 2025, Employee #1 and Employee #2 and Coworker #1 and Coworker #2 , were applying CTS Cement Rapid Set Mortar Mix on an exposed fieldstone foundation wall to reinforce the deteriorating wall. The crew was working inside a trench that was approximately 34-foot-long by 3-foot-wide by 6-foot-deep in type C soil. Employees #1 and Employee #2 were working in the eastern side of the trench while Coworker #1 and Coworker #2 were working in the southern side of the trench. Coworker #3, was also working inside the the eastern side of the trench, but was tasked to dig below the base of the foundation wall. Coworker #3 exited the trench and either Employee #1 or Employee #2 took Coworker #3's place. The foundation wall excavated and dug underneath the wall using shovels and a rotary hammer to create a concrete foundation. No cave-in protection or shoring was used. The eastern side of the wall fell into the trench striking Employee #1 and Employee #2, fatally injuring both employees.

title: Employee is fatally injured in fall through roof skylight
narrative: At 10:00 a.m. on February 28, 2025, Employee #1 was working as a laborer for a warehouse. The employee was sent up onto the roof when he fell through a skylight and sustained fatal injuries.

title: Employee is fatally injured when struck by load from reach t
narrative: At 12:00 a.m. on February 27, 2025, Employee #1 was walking through the pedestrian walkway at the entrance of a facility when an unstable load fell from a narrow aisle reach truck and struck the employee. The employee sustained fatal injuries.

title: Employee is fatally injured when struck by falling Blowout P
narrative: At approximately 3:56 p.m. on February 26, 2025, employees were in the process of removing a Blowout Preventer (BOP) from a wellhead using a forklift and rigging. After completing the rigging process, Employee #1 was assisting with the lift when the chain securing the BOP slipped off the forks of the forklift. The BOP fell and struck Employee #1, resulting in fatal injuries.

title: Employee is fatally injured during tree removal operation
narrative: At approximately 9:30 a.m. on February 25, 2025, Employee #1 was using a chain saw to cut a section of a tree trunk that was lying horizontally with its root ball positioned vertically, 90 degrees to the ground. After the trunk section was cut, the root ball rotated and returned to a vertical position, striking the ground with its roots. The impact caused another tree to fall, and it struck the employee. Employee #1 sustained fatal injuries.

title: One employee is fatally injured, another employee suffers sh
narrative: At 8:30 a.m. on February 25, 2025, Employee #1 and Employee #2 were working as carpenters and were installing metal framing on the exterior of a multi-family dwelling. The employees were working from an Articulating Boom Lift when the boom contacted a 7,200-Volt primary overhead powerline. Employee #1 exited the lift basket and touched conductive material on the exterior of the building. Employee #1 was electrocuted and Employee #2 suffered electrical shock requiring hospitalization. Employee #1 sustained fatal injuries.

title: Employee is electrocuted while replacing fuses on electrical
narrative: At approximately 4:20 a.m. on February 25, 2025, Employee #1 was working on an AirTrain switch electrical panel, attempting to replace blown fuses. During the task, the employee came into contact with energized components and received a 600-volt electric shock. Employee #1 was fatally electrocuted.

title: Employee is fatally injured, canopy being demolished falls
narrative: At 6:45 a.m. on February 24, 2025, Employee #1 was working as a construction laborer and was tearing down a hotel entrance canopy. The canopy also served as a carport for arriving guests. Employee #1 was under the canopy when it suddenly collapsed. Employee #1 was fatally injured.

title: Employee wearing supplied air respirator is asphyxiated whil
narrative: At 11:43 a.m. on February 24, 2025, Employee #1 was spray painting aircraft parts while wearing a supplied air respirator. Nitrogen back flowed into the breathing air system, displacing oxygen and causing the employee to be asphyxiated. Employee #1 was fatally injured.

title: Employee is fatally injured when caught in auger while insid
narrative: At approximately 7:00 p.m. on February 24, 2025, Employee #1 entered a grain bin while operating an auger. While inside the bin, the employee was caught in the sweep auger and sustained fatal injuries.
